fjtm7pwtshp0pINSERT /*+ APPEND NOLOGGING */ INTO GLBSAD.TMPFDAYSTART2 (AC_TYPE, ACMASTCODE, AC_NO, BAL, BALANCE) SELECT A.AC_TYPE, A.ACMASTCODE, A.AC_NO, SUM(NVL(B.DEBIT, :"SYS_B_00")-NVL(B.CREDIT, :"SYS_B_01")) AS BAL, :"SYS_B_02" AS BALANCE FROM GLBSAD.TMPFDAYSTART1 A, ACBK B WHERE A.ACMASTCODE=B.ACMASTCODE AND A.AC_NO=B.AC_NO AND A.AC_TYPE=B.AC_TYPE AND B.AC_TYPE IN (:"SYS_B_03", :"SYS_B_04", :"SYS_B_05", :"SYS_B_06", :"SYS_B_07", :"SYS_B_08") AND A.AC_TYPE IN (:"SYS_B_09", :"SYS_B_10", :"SYS_B_11", :"SYS_B_12", :"SYS_B_13", :"SYS_B_14") AND B.TDATE<TO_DATE(:"SYS_B_15", :"SYS_B_16") AND NVL(B.POST, :"SYS_B_17")=:"SYS_B_18" AND NVL(B.CNCLED, :"SYS_B_19")=:"SYS_B_20" GROUP BY A.AC_TYPE, A.ACMASTCODE, A.AC_NO
